d: Can a spoon become a million-dollar business idea? Indian-origin designer Rahul Agarwal has reimagined the humble measuring spoon with a foldable design that saves space in the kitchen. His company, Polygons Design, secured a $350,000 deal on Shark Tank USA. But this is not the first time a simple idea has turned into a successful business. How did Rahul secure such a massive deal for a spoon idea? Palki Sharma brings you the details.
